name: spark
description: AI electronics design. Checks a design made of modules plugged into a dev board for the mistakes no EDA tool catches: a wake source on a pin that cannot wake the chip, an analogue input on a digital-only pin, two parts on one pin, a serial module on the boot-log UART, and two I2C devices at one address. Also bundles ESP32/PCB design-rule checklists, a verified-parts library, vendor-knowledge ingestion (Espressif, Seeed and DFRobot), a photo-to-schematic reverse-engineering procedure, and a verification gate that refuses to emit a board with unverified part pins.
